job.title: Security Engineer II, Security Incident Response Team (SIRT)
job.pay_full: $159,300 – $202,400 a year base salary (Arlington, VA), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Amazon's Security Incident Response Team (SIRT), part of its Information Security organisation, responds to security events, analyses threats such as malware and intrusion attempts, and protects highly sensitive data. Engineers work hands-on with detection systems and vulnerability analysis tools, gather and analyse event data, and run root-cause analysis to protect the applications behind Amazon's e-commerce platform. The team values broad and deep knowledge in forensics, malware analysis, network and application security, threat hunting and threat intelligence.
duties: Respond to security incidents and coordinate a cohesive response across multiple Amazon teams
Provide security engineering support during customer-facing incidents and help prevent similar ones
Help develop pragmatic solutions that meet business requirements at an acceptable level of risk
Identify and recommend ways to improve or expand Amazon's incident response capabilities
Work alongside and mentor Information Security engineers
Assess how security trends, advisories, publications and research affect Amazon and coordinate responses
Keep your skills current with the changing threat landscape
Take part in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation
needs: 3+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C++ or a similar object-oriented language
2+ years of scripting, programming and security code review in a common language (non-internship)
2+ years troubleshooting systems issues, analysing logs or automating basic tasks with command-line tools (non-internship)
Bachelor's degree in a STEM field, or experience in IT security
Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
Knowledge of industry security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques
nice: 2+ years in any combination of threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security
Knowledge of command-line tools to troubleshoot protocols, analyse logs or automate tasks
Experience with AWS products and services
Security work across the software development lifecycle, such as security design review, threat modeling, secure code review and security testing
details.benefits: Base salary $159,300 – $202,400 a year (Arlington, VA). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon Security encourages candidates to apply even if they don't meet every qualification
Flexible work hours and arrangements are part of the team's culture
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
